mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_eval_job ( user_id, start_at, end_at, include_llm_judge, limit_count, status, total, processed, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{includeLlmJudge}, #{limitCount}, #{status}, #{total}, #{processed}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, start_at, end_at, include_llm_judge, limit_count, status, total, processed, report_json, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_eval_job WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_eval_job SET status = 'RUNNING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE diet_eval_job SET status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE
